title: MikoPBX module application, schema version 1
description: applications/<module_id>/application.yaml. tools/validate.py applies this schema, then the checks that need more than one field, the registry or the repository. Operator-only settings (trust level, price, images, rules, budget) are not part of it: a pull request cannot set them.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Only 1 exists.

module_id.description: moduleUniqueID in module.json at `commit`, and the name of the application's directory. The intersection of what Core installs (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$), what REST v3 can address (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$) and what the marketplace server allocates (^Module[A-Za-z0-9]{1,60}$).

publisher_id.description: The publisher's id in the MIKO publisher cabinet. Not proof of identity: it is checked against the confirmed publisher.

repo.description: The public GitHub repository with the module's source. Required: unlike the optional source_url of the catalogue, it is what the checks build from.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit SHA the checks build and MIKO approves. A branch, a tag or a short SHA is not accepted.

license.description: SPDX license expression, for example GPL-3.0-or-later.

support_email.description: Public support address. Must equal support_email in module.json and the address on the publisher's card.

maintainers.description: GitHub logins of the people who maintain the module.

homepage.description: Optional https:// page about the module.

compatibility.description: Which MikoPBX versions and architectures the module supports. It selects the test matrix; the images themselves come from MIKO's config/mikopbx.yaml.

min_pbx_version.description: Lowest MikoPBX version. Must be at least min_pbx_version in module.json.

max_pbx_version.description: Highest MikoPBX version, or null. Core does not enforce it; it only narrows the test matrix.

architectures.description: Architectures the module supports; each gets a test run.
